title: Reproduce a sealed correlation and covariance profile of four channels
goal: Reproduce the sealed dependence profile of the four channels in assets/gc-389/data.csv: all six pairwise Pearson correlations, two Spearman correlations with average-rank tie handling, and the trace and determinant of the sample covariance matrix, per assets/gc-389/spec.md, into artifacts/gc-389/stats.json. Plan the estimator conventions first, implement the pipeline, and self-verify the determinant with a second method before grading. Then run the grader and close every named mismatch across verify cycles until stats_matched = 12.
resources: assets/gc-389/data.csv (bundled dataset slice, sealed by sha256)
assets/gc-389/spec.md (exact statistic definitions and submission contract)
pypi:numpy==1.26.4 (optional, for the agent-side pipeline only)
pypi:pandas==2.2.2 (optional, for the agent-side pipeline only)
process_expectations: A plan artifact (e.g., plan.md) exists before any pipeline code and restates all 12 statistic definitions from spec.md in the agent's own words.
Intermediate self-verification commands ran, with captured output, before the first grader invocation.
A second, independent computation path (different library or hand-rolled code) was run for the highest-risk statistics and the reconciliation is recorded.
Every RED grader run is followed by a log entry naming the mismatched statistics (identities, not counts) and the specific definition fix applied to each.
Cost and wall-clock are logged honestly per phase (plan / implement / verify), including failed attempts.

assets_visibility.note: sealed files live in the maintainers' private sealed pack; public repo keeps <name>.sha256 commitments. Restore with tools/restore_sealed.py before grading these cards.
